correctness.rationale: The geometric classification is proved for every field by projecting from a coordinate node, using the smooth conic Q and the degree-six base scheme Q∩C, and yields exactly six edges and three diagonals. At every edge, the displayed four Grassmannian cubic coefficient polynomials map surjectively to Z[u,v]/(u²,v²) via a=u,c=v,b=-u+2uv,d=-v+2uv, giving a genuine closed rank-four subscheme. At each diagonal, the four-by-four Jacobian has determinant -1 over Z. The Grassmannian rank-four section has zero-dimensional fibers of length c4=27 by the explicit Schubert coefficient. The constructed 3+6·4=27 subscheme fills every fiber, and proper/quasi-finite finiteness plus flat base change and Nakayama proves the global integral scheme isomorphism. The attached exact-arithmetic verifier independently checks all critical polynomial identities, determinant units, Chern coefficient, and complete line enumeration over F2,F3,F5; finite tests are corroborative, not the all-characteristic proof.

originality.rationale: The exact reduced set of 9 Cayley lines, divided into 6 edges and 3 diagonals, was published in Heath-Brown (arXiv:math/0210333, 2002), and a systematic 2014 Cox-ring classification lists 9 lines for the 4A1 cubic. Such results also make the known smooth-cubic top Chern degree 27 an unsurprising conservation law. The assessed advance is instead the **complete integral relative Hilbert-scheme isomorphism**, including the six explicit rank-four flat Artin thickenings and three integral reduced sections, valid over every residue characteristic. Neither accessible relevant primary full text states the scheme structure or an implication yielding it, and searches of exact formulations and related mathematical records found no covering result. Historical priority remains qualified against specialist sources on degenerating Fano schemes.

value.rationale: The canonical Fano scheme of the uniquely maximally four-nodal Cayley cubic is a natural and important degeneration of the 27-line configuration. Reduced support data leave its deformation and collision multiplicities unresolved. The theorem gives a complete classification of nine local Artin factors over the integers, including their (1,2,1) Hilbert functions and characteristic independence. That exact flat integral structure is a substantive invariant of the degeneration, not an arbitrary finite calculation, routine increment or restatement of the classical nine-line support count.
